comparison.objective: Candidate configures a robot gripper; this record installs a glass unit on two setting blocks in a window frame.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses coaxial hand tools; the record places small supports, bimanually guides fragile glazing through narrow clearance, and lowers it without sill contact.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked opening over cycles; the record checks block positions, glass support and centering, release, stability, and permanent failure on sill contact.
comparison.reason: Fragile insertion and load placement on supports have no coupled threaded adjustment or functional-cycle requirement.
